result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue: the metadata line under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has overlapping text, making the delivery details unreadable.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the line beneath 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' renders with colliding text — '25-30' overlaps 'delivery', appearing as '25-30delivery · Ramen'. The delivery time and fee run into each other so the information cannot be read.
issues.suggestion: Give the metadata items separate layout slots with proper spacing and a delimiter, e.g. '25–30 min · €0 delivery · Ramen', and ensure the text elements cannot overlap.
